Crisp Air. Golden Light. Pumpkins Everywhere!
Autumn transforms Filoli into a celebration of the season, where golden light, vibrant foliage, and harvest displays invite you to slow down and enjoy the changing landscape.
Stroll through the Garden to discover pumpkins, giant gourds, scarecrows, ornamental grasses, and a vintage red pickup truck that sets the perfect backdrop for your Autumn reels. Then step inside the historic House to experience it's unique warm, timeless beauty.
Before you leave, sip warm apple cider, enjoy seasonal treats, and capture a few unforgettable fall memories along the way.

Family Fun All Fall Long
Soak up all the colors, textures, and picture-perfect moments of fall at Filoli. Wander through golden grasses and vibrant autumn displays, explore the Autumn Railway, and get lost (just a little) in the Hay Maze.
Meet the quirky characters of the Scarecrow Field and choose your favorite pumpkin-headed scarecrow. Pose by the vintage Pumpkin Truck, explore the Pumpkin Meadow, and capture those perfect family fall photos against one of the Bay Area’s most beautiful autumn backdrops.
With seasonal color around every corner and plenty for little ones to explore, Autumn Days at Filoli is made for crisp fall days, family time, and a camera roll full of memories.

Service Learning
Get outside. Learn something new. Make a difference.
Service Learning at Filoli is a hands-on way to 
spend time in the gardens while picking up real skills from our expert team
. Each session combines a short learning moment with time working alongside staff to care for the estate. Come once or come back anytime. No long-term commitment. 
Service Learning is a free program, just reserve your spot.
This fall, help us prepare for the Holiday season the Filoli way! It’s a feel-good way to be outdoors, meet people, and leave knowing you helped keep this place beautiful.
